text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank 160 x 110 mm, 4 mm aluminium. Square the edges, deburr,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: round the corners to about 2 mm. Measure every hole from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plate's centre lines; the hole layout picture repeats them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Corner holes: four 6.6 mm (M6 clearance), 70 mm each side along the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: length and 45 mm each side across (140 x 90 mm apart).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Box standoff holes: four M4 tapped, drill 3.3 mm and tap,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 40 mm each side along and 20 mm each side across (80 x 40 apart).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: IMU holes: two M3 tapped, drill 2.5 mm and tap, 7 mm each side of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the cross centre line, 5 mm to the right of the long centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Better: drill the IMU and standoff holes through the box floor

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with the box clamped on the plate, then open the floor holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the box floor sits flat on the top face; nothing may stick out

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: below the plate, so the standoffs and screws stop inside it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: every tapped hole takes its screw by hand.
